b'# TinyDL CLI

This tool allows you to download data from a given URL.

## Usage

```bash
tinydl <URL> [options]
```

## Options

| Option | Short | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `url` | (positional) | The URL from which to download the data. |
| `-o`, `--output` | `-o`, `--output` | File to write the downloaded data to. Defaults to standard output (stdout). |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | `-q`, `--quiet` | Suppress progress output. |'
